authorization: user requested sequential execution of continuity diagnosis, small RAW demonstration fitting, then Normal closed loop
scope: bounded development work, not P3/P4; preserve all attempts; no RGB teacher or expert-action policy replay

diagnostics: fixed observation x four flow seeds
stages.next_candidate: fixed flow noise, unchanged native50 execution; native reference must pass before RAW closed-loop candidate

stages.enabled_after: stage 1 findings and execution witness recorded
stages.training_pool: lexicographically selected 1 or 3 Normal train episodes; seed0 and dev/calibration remain excluded
stages.fit_measure: fully sampled control actions on declared training landmarks, joints and grippers separately, multiple predeclared flow seeds
stages.stop: nonfinite gradients/loss or inability to fit training landmarks after bounded budget; do not silently extend

stages.acceptance: unchanged two-hand contact, no table contact, z >= 0.83m, continuous 1s then passive 2s
